# FFT powers

Fast Fourier Transform (FFT): powers

## Usage

``` r
fft_powers(f)
```

## Arguments

- f:

  num. The Fourier coefficients.

## Value

\\P\\ array of powers, \\P\[n\] = \|c\_{n}\|\\ for
\\n=1,\ldots,\ell-1\\.

## Details

The power of the \\n\\-th harmonics is \$\$\|c\_{n}\| =
\sqrt{a\_{n}^{2}+b\_{n}^{2}}\\,\$\$ its frequency is \\n/T\\ and period
\\T/n\\, for \\n=1,\ldots,\ell-1\\.

## Examples

``` r
fft_rfft(hobo$t_hobo[1:(24 * 5)]) %>%
  fft_powers()
```
